adding-friends-can-make-me-stronger:
Crossing into a fantasy world, Meng Changqing thought he would live an ordinary life, but he unexpectedly awakened a friend system!
As long as the other party agrees to become his friend, even if it’s just verbally, he can obtain corresponding attributes from the other party, as well as additional rewards!
“Adding the True Legend of the sect as a friend, obtaining attribute: First-class aptitude!”
“Adding the Sect Leader as a friend, obtaining attribute: Perfect-level ‘Indestructible True King Art’!”
“Adding the dragon girl of the demon race as a friend, obtaining attribute: True Dragon Bloodline!”
“Adding the Sword Immortal as a friend, obtaining attribute: Chaotic Sword Body!”
“…”
So Meng Changqing began his journey of “relying on friends” for cultivation.
As for those who are unwilling to be his friends, Meng Changqing can only draw his long sword from his waist and make friends with his noble character.
after-the-divorce-i-could-hear-the-voice:
After his divorce, Lu Liang suddenly felt as if he was already half-buried now, after all, he could hear the sound of a revolving lantern, a sign of impending death.
But then, he discovered that the noise was actually messages from the future, leading to a dramatic turn in his life.
...
Living in the secular world, we are all ordinary people.
Being ordinary isn't too bad; greedy for wealth, lustful, dark-hearted, selfish...
[Not a single female lead, enter at your own discretion]
apocalypse-rebate-spoiling-beauties-make:
Let’s be honest, you already know how this story goes...
A broke nobody gets a cool system that rewards him for simping on ladies.
*Multiple face-slapping marathons later*
He becomes a rich tycoon surrounded by beauties, riches, and probably a few babies mixed in.
So I’m not even going to try claiming this is going to be any different.
But you see, there’s a twist.
What if you were transmigrated into such a story?
Except, unlike the others, this one takes place in a post-apocalyptic world.
A world filled with Mutants, Ghouls, and Dragons with scales impervious to even heavy artillery weapons.
Where nearly everyone Awakens an Ability to protect themselves against them.
And strength dictates all.
While everyone else is grinding and pushing themselves to the brink of death, all you have to do is spend money on a few beauties and gain an absurd amount of wealth in return.
And instead of the usual rich-tycoon routine, this time you have a system capable of exchanging practically anything for money.
Some say money can’t buy everything.
But turns out, it can.
All you need is a system to help make the transaction possible.…
banging-the-hot-milfs-of-tokyo:
“Sex, Hot Sex, and More Hot, Unstoppable Sex! They want to ride me, squirt and make me punish them. That’s all these high-powered women in Tokyo crave. And who am I to say no when they offer it all to me with a cash reward attached to it?”
Yuki Mori is a broke, 21-year-old college student on the brink of finishing his tech degree. Struggling to make ends meet, he stumbles across a high-paying job offer with flexible hours—“Private Servicing Assistant Needed.” Expecting nothing more than cleaning for a high-end fashion store, Yuki is thrilled when he lands the gig.
But he couldn’t be more wrong.
When Yuki meets Katashi Kurica, the stunning, 32-year-old CEO of Kurica Fashion House, he quickly learns that this isn’t just a job. Katashi is a powerful, seductive woman who doesn’t take no for an answer—and what she wants is him.
Nervously, Yuki signs the contract, but it’s only when she calls him to her penthouse that the truth is revealed. “You’ll be servicing me. Not the floors.”
For Yuki, a virgin with no experience in the ways of the world, the offer is shocking.…
beastmaster-of-the-ages-novel:
Even in his dreams, Li Tianming can’t stop himself from laughing! Why? Because, his family pets are all the Primordial Chaos Beasts of myth!
That teeny weeny little chick over there is actually the Aeternal Infernal Phoenix that eats suns! His black cat is the Genesis Chaos Thunderfiend that refines worlds with its lightning. The c*ckroach, well, it’s the Myriad Worlds Deathless Beast that possesses trillions of undying clones…
Followed by his menagerie of pets, Li Tianming begins his ascension to become the number one beastmaster of the ages. He journeys across the many worlds, only one thing remaining constant. No one is ever ready for the likes of his pets! After all, who’s ever prepared to fight a chicken and its fellows…
being-a-late-bloomer-in-the-cultivation-:
Wei Tu transmigrated into a Cultivation world and awakened the [Late Bloomer] Destiny.
[Destiny: Late Bloomer.]
[Attribute: Indomitable perseverance; bound for greatness.]
Seeing this Destiny, hope finally reignited in Wei Tu’s heart, which had long been worn down by the harsh realities of life. Yet, he still didn’t know if someone with such humble origins like himself could truly ascend to immortality and become a patriarch.
At least for now, all he could do was seize the present and cherish his current, simple life—his wife, his kids, and a warm hearth.
black-and-white-martial-emperor:
Yeon Hojeong, the first to unite the dark factions as the Grandmaster of the Underworld, collaborates with the orthodox sects to overcome the chaos of the Three Sects. However, he meets an untimely end, entangled in the schemes of the Martial Alliance Leader.
“This is really my home!”
When he opens his eyes, he finds himself in the prestigious and once-destroyed Yeon family, a place he never forgot.
“I won’t make a mistake this time. Never.”
Determined to prevent the fall of his family and the future upheaval caused by the Three Sects, he embarks on a relentless journey! The struggle of Yeon Hojeong, the eldest son, to unite the martial world.
black-ghoul:
[WARNING: MATURE CONTENTS]
Set in the city of New York, The story begins with Liam and Jenna O'Brien, abandoned by their father, soon later the death of their mother leaving the two siblings in the difficult world.
Liam being the father figure wants nothing more than to make sure his kid sis get through school and have a good life, but all that changed when Jenna is wanted for killing three of her classmates, why she did it wasn't much of the question... it was how she did.
Now becoming a target of both ghouls and G.I agents [Ghoul Investigators] Both siblings are thrust into a world of pain and rejection, hunted in the city as 'New York's Most Wanted'
A young female ghoul, Riley Leah, comes to their recuse giving them a choice of hiding forever or dying.
Will they survive the hunt? Or is a sibling bond stronger than any other thing? Well, you will just have to find out.
blackout-ascension-return-of-primordial-:

Seyana Solaris, the Princess of the Sun Kingdom, suddenly awakens a divine power known as 'Divinity'. Her awakening shifts the balance of the world. The terrifying Black Mist Knights descend to hunt her, and Malgreth the legendary Demon Lord who waited in the shadows for 300 years finally makes his move to devour her 'Divinity' and conquer all.
As the world moves towards war and Seyana becomes a target for monsters and mysterious entities, Kairos's mind sends a Blackout Signal flashes about Ascension.
[SEAL BROKEN!]
[LETHAL THREAT INCOMING!]
[ASCEND AS PRIMORDIAL HEIR? YES / NO]

cooking-gourmet-meals-in-the-apocalypse:
Cheng Xing survived ten brutal years in the apocalypse, only to die betrayed by the people she trusted most.
When she opens her eyes again, she's back to day one.
The world hasn't ended yet. Everyone is still unconscious.
And this time, she knows exactly what's coming.
With a spatial storage that grows with every upgrade, she raids entire malls, hoards livestock, and builds a self-sustaining farm.
But survival alone isn't the goal. Living well is.
While everyone else fights over stale bread, she's pan-searing wagyu beef.
While former allies scramble for shelter, she's barbecuing lamb skewers on the rooftop and livestreaming.
The woman who betrayed her last life?
The researchers who treated her like a lab rat?
Now watching from downstairs, starving.
emperor-of-solo-play: Year 2035. The virtual reality game, Warlord, changed the world. An Jaehyun was one of the many who wished to change his life through the game. After dedicating his life to the game, he was met with a betrayal. A betrayal by his comrades. As a result, he lost everything. But a chance was given to him. A chance to redo everything again! “I won’t play with others ever again. Whatever the outcome, I’ll show that I can do it alone.” Others rolled a dice to split the spoils of victory. An Jaehyun ate it all by himself. It was the start of An Jaehyun’s solo game life.
entry-editing-loyal-succubus-nun:

harry-potter-and-the-dovahkiin:
Ben was having the worst day of his life—then he died. But instead of moving on to whatever comes next, he woke up in the Wizarding World as Benedict Brown, the alternate male version of Lavender Brown. Before the age of 18, he is fated to turn misfortune into good fortune and calamity into auspiciousness; at 18, he can solve the Mystery of the Womb.
With each reincarnation, based on the evaluation of that life, his Spirit Root can increase by 0-5 points.

i-learned-magic-for-all-the-wrong-reason:
Dante had rehearsed his villain speeches for years, but he had never prepared for a beautiful woman to take one seriously and ask who they were getting rid of.
At Blackwell University of Arcane Studies, everyone could do magic, which should have made him another first year struggling through the basics. Instead, every spell he cast made the women around him pay a little more attention, trust his explanations a little faster, and question his decisions a little less.
For a self proclaimed roleplayer who had spent years imagining himself in charge, this seemed like an excellent reason to keep practicing. His mysterious warnings finally had an audience, and saying “I planned for this” usually bought him enough time to come up with something he could pretend had been the plan all along.
Dante assumed he was becoming the man he had always wanted to be, especially when witches who could put him through a wall started asking what he wanted them to do. Admitting he had borrowed half his speeches from anime would have ruined things, so he kept talking and hoped he would learn enough magic to deserve their confidence.…

One bad review. One furious goddess. One life completely upended.

my-talent-column-is-empty-so-i-steal-eve:
Everyone in Pantheon gets a Talent.
Ren Blackwell gets a blank column.
No grade. No class recommendation. No starter package. According to the game, there is simply nothing there, which would be a problem if Ren had planned on playing fair.
Then he kills an elite monster.
[Plunder available.]
The monster had an ability Ren wanted.
So he took it.
Later, he discovers monsters aren't the only valid targets.
Skills. Affinities. Abilities that were never meant for humans. Powers belonging to other players.
Pantheon gave everyone else something special at character creation.
Ren got access to everyone else's.
And in a game where gold can become real money, rare abilities can make careers, and the strongest players are already racing ahead, an empty Talent Column might be the best thing that ever happened to him.

pay-to-win-support-player-my-system-runs:
Eight hundred years after the apocalypse, humanity survives behind massive walls, and the “Awakened” rule everyone else like gods.
Michael Kaiser was never supposed to be one of them. An abusive, gambling father. A mother who was never around. A little sister who needed him to keep working instead of dreaming. The world had already written his ending before his Awakening ceremony even started.
Then the testing stone cracks under him, like it can't hold what's inside.
No combat class. No blade of light, no storm of flame. Just a blinding teal glow, the color of a support class, wrapped around a platinum core no one has ever seen before. The highest-ranked skill in recorded history.
But there's no spellbook waiting in his head. There's a shop.
[The Pay-To-Win System has been activated. You can purchase anything in this world — as long as you can afford it.]
The rules are absolute. No loans. No handouts. No rich benefactor bailing him out. Every stat point, every world-breaking skill, every miracle has a price — and it only accepts money he earns with his own two hands.
His first mission is already counting down: Earn $500 by midnight, or forfeit your first draw. Permanently.…
primordial-monster-girl-tamer:

Tez was a lawyer with a dark past.
He never became a lawyer to uphold justice or protect the innocent. He became one because he believed in one simple truth: the law was the only thing he could trust.
As long as he understood the rules, he believed he could make sure he would never lose again.
But everything changed when he decided to play a strange virtual game he discovered online.
Instead of waking up in his own world, Tez finds himself transmigrated into Tera, a world eerily similar to the game he had played—the Kingdom of Dracoris.

And Tez?

No family. No status. No power.

Monster Girl Tamer System.
With the ability to tame powerful monsters—including beautiful monster girls—Tez finally gains the means to carve out his own path.

protect-our-clan-leader:
The main character has transmigrated to a Mysterious Fantasy Land as a ‘Clan Leader’. This is an attempt to paint a realistic reimagination of this mystical world from the perspective of a family member, be it nurturing Spirit Fields, raising Spirit Fish, and developing clan industries on all fronts. While supporting those undeserving elders, our main character becomes their protection, inspiring the younger generation to make a name for themselves by bravely venturing into the Sacred Land’s Academies.
The family members in this story are harmonious and unified, working together in a concerted effort for a shared future.
This fantasy world is not about passionate battles, but rather, it focuses on the enhancement of various family industries, where elements like monetary resources, facilities, house servants, household generals, clan members, relatives, and in-laws are key.
Enjoy this attempt to view the stereotypical Mysterious Fantasy world from a fresh perspective.
re-my-dragon-girlfriend-in-the-dragonic-:

Dragons destroying everything in sight.
A new world rising from the ashes.

reawakening-i-can-absorb-infinite-skills:

The son of the noble Caelum family is cast out, and tagged useless because he couldn't awaken an elemental affinity.

But that’s when Arden woke up.
A forty-year-old man from Earth who died trying to be a hero finds himself reborn in the body of the abandoned boy, armed with nothing but fading memories and a burning thirst for adventure. But fate isn't done with him yet.
Because death triggered something new—
The Life Signature System.
Now, every creature he defeats leaves behind power, instincts, and skills he can absorb. From raw speed to beast like senses, Arden grows with each kill. He doesn't need elemental magic. His strength is something deeper.
In a world ruled by clans, affinities, and ancient bloodlines, a new kind of monster is rising from the Outlands
And this time, he's not just surviving
He's coming for everything.
rebirth-the-new-bride-wants-a-divorce:
Anna thought her life ended the moment she saw her husband, Daniel Clafford, in the arms of her sister.
She had already lost her unborn child something Daniel never even noticed and now, with her last shred of hope shattered, she decided to leave quietly.
But fate was cruel. Before she could walk away, she was pushed off the balcony of the Clafford estate.
Only… she didn’t die.
When she opened her eyes again, she was back on the day of her wedding, her sister having run away and Anna forced to take her place as the replacement bride.
This time, Anna swore things would be different. No love. No expectations. No more foolish devotion to a husband who only brought her heartbreak and cold indifference.
Yet something is wrong.
The Daniel of this life isn’t the same man she remembers. He refuses to ignore her, refuses to let her go, and most shockingly—refuses to divorce her.
“I’m telling you, Anna. Stop bringing divorce into our conversations,” Daniel warned, his voice taut.
His heart ached, but seeing her unyielding expression made his resolve crumble. With trembling hands, he cupped her face and whispered:
“Please… give me a chance. I promise I’ll love you right this time.…
reborn-as-a-slum-prince-my-kingdom-syste:
Leon Ashford died with nothing.
Once a powerful billionaire on Earth, betrayal from those closest to him cost him everything—including his life.
When he opens his eyes again, he finds himself in the body of the most hated prince in the Kingdom of Aurelia.
A prince abandoned by the royal family.
A prince exiled to the slums.
A prince destined to die.
Just when all hope seems lost, a mysterious notification appears.
[Kingdom Evolution System Activated!]

[Recruit talented individuals.]

“Who are these two little boys?”

starting-from-primitive-world-building-t:
Enzo ventured into the primitive era, chosen as a priest by the Crimson Star tribe and emerging as the leader, awakening numerous extraordinary abilities in the process.
In order to enhance their way of life, extensive reforms became necessary.
Mystical sorcery and modern technology advanced hand in hand.
While other tribes still dwelled in caves, the Crimson Star tribe had already gained prominence, constructing sturdy brick houses.
While other tribes were still using primitive wooden spears and stones, the Crimson Star tribe had forged ahead with iron tools.
In the midst of other tribes worrying about food scarcity, the Crimson Star tribe was reaping bountiful harvests of various grains.
Furthermore, they possessed an unparalleled army of totem warriors.
In response, Enzo, embraced by the luscious temptress and leading the enigmatic cat maiden, earnestly expressed, “I truly only sought to improve our way of life. How did I inadvertently elevate the tribe into a divine realm?”

Su Chengyu took the blame for his wife and went to prison for three years. Upon release, he realized that she had betrayed him.
Despite this, he benefited from misfortune and comprehended the Dao, stepping into the world of immortal cultivators. He could easily master immortal techniques and ancient martial arts. He could also refine pills, draw talismans, treat illnesses, and save people at will!
Su Chengyu postured crazily in the Red Dust City, vowing to find out the truth behind the death of his 127 Su family members 26 years ago.

Arion is a dominant alpha whose power comes with a brutal truth: without a mate, he is dangerously close to madness.
If he goes berserk, entire regions could pay the price.
Dean is the only solution.
Now bound by his choice, Dean must leave everything familiar behind and step into Alamina’s court, where patience is lethal, possession is quiet but absolute, and Arion’s restraint rests on him alone.

What he didn’t know was how dangerous being chosen back would be.
the-blood-contract:
WARNING: DARK AND MATURE CONTENT. Readers discretion advised.
Serena Alaric wanted nothing more than a quiet life, far from the shadows of her family’s dark past. But when masked enforcers storm her home and drag her into the clutches of the Council of Vitae, she learns her blood is the key to a deadly legacy she never asked for.
Lucian Draven is the cold and ruthless leader of a powerful mafia syndicate, cursed to endure unimaginable pain. The Council claims Serena is his only salvation. But with enemies closing in from all sides and time running out, Serena and Lucian must decide: will they fight their fates, or embrace the dangerous connection that could either save them, or destroy them both?

-the shit of a life she was living was horrible, but it was bearable, and so she got used to it.

Money - bountiful enough that when she has to spend, she doesn't need to look back or calculate her assets to see how much she has left.
Money - bountiful enough to get all the fried chicken she could ever dream of. Yeah, you heard it, fried chicken.
For those who did not have money to spare leisurely, getting fried chicken was like a pipe dream to them and she had been one of those unfortunate souls.
